# hyperfluid_nextflow (Resource)

The Nextflow deployment of an environment; runs are launched with `hfctl`. Needs the organization's `nextflow_enabled` feature.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperfluid_environment" "default" {
  name = "default"
}

resource "hyperfluid_nextflow" "genomics" {
  env     = data.hyperfluid_environment.default.id
  name    = "genomics"
  buckets = ["reads", "results"]

  egress = {
    fqdns = ["github.com", "*.githubusercontent.com"]
  }

  # Omit storage, head and task_quota to let the platform size them.
  storage = {
    size = "500Gi"
  }

  task_quota = {
    cpu      = "64"
    memory   = "256Gi"
    max_pods = 50
  }

  scm = {
    platform     = "github"
    token_secret = "github-token"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `env` (String) Environment id. Changing this forces a new deployment.
- `name` (String) Name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Changing this forces a new deployment.

### Optional

- `buckets` (Set of String) Environment buckets the pipelines may read and write.
- `config` (String) Nextflow configuration applied to every run.
- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `egress` (Attributes) Egress granted on top of the platform baseline. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--egress))
- `head` (Attributes) Head pod sizing; an omitted value uses the platform default. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--head))
- `runtime_image` (String) Runtime image replacing the platform's.
- `scm` (Attributes) Private Git provider pipelines are pulled from. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scm))
- `storage` (Attributes) Shared work volume; omitted values use the platform default, and removing the block keeps the volume. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage))
- `tags` (List of String) User-defined tags.
- `task_quota` (Attributes) Ceiling on the tasks of all runs; an omitted value uses the platform default. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--task_quota))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `phase` (String) Lifecycle phase: `Pending`, `Provisioning`, `Ready` or `Error`.
- `resolved_runtime_image` (String) Runtime image in use.
- `slug` (String) Derived slug.
- `task_namespace` (String) Namespace the tasks run in.
- `work_volume_capacity` (String) Bound capacity of the work volume.

<a id="nestedatt--egress"></a>
### Nested Schema for `egress`

Optional:

- `allowlists` (Set of String) Names of the environment's egress allow-lists to attach.
- `fqdns` (Set of String) Public hostnames reachable on port 443, in lowercase.


<a id="nestedatt--head"></a>
### Nested Schema for `head`

Optional:

- `cpu` (String) CPU, as a Kubernetes quantity.
- `memory` (String) Memory, as a Kubernetes quantity.


<a id="nestedatt--scm"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scm`

Required:

- `platform` (String) `github`, `gitlab`, `gitea` or `bitbucket`.
- `token_secret` (String) Name of the secret holding the access token.

Optional:

- `server` (String) `https://` URL of a self-hosted server.
- `user` (String) User the token belongs to.


<a id="nestedatt--storage"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage`

Optional:

- `size` (String) Size, as a Kubernetes quantity; it can grow but not shrink.
- `storage_class_name` (String) `ReadWriteMany` storage class. Changing this forces a new deployment.


<a id="nestedatt--task_quota"></a>
### Nested Schema for `task_quota`

Optional:

- `cpu` (String) Total CPU, as a Kubernetes quantity.
- `max_pods` (Number) Maximum number of task pods.
- `memory` (String) Total memory, as a Kubernetes quantity.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Nextflow import id is the deployment id (uuid).
terraform import hyperfluid_nextflow.genomics 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
